Name: Red Panda Pet
Author: HoneyBeeTea
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds a red panda as a new pet! I used the cat's code as a base, so it will do the same actions and give the same gifts. Maybe I'll go back later and change those up if people want.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Doesn't replace existing pets and should work with other pet mods.[/color]
[center][img width=150,height=150]https://i.ibb.co/N23Zrvp6/Walking-Down.gif[/img][/center]
[size=4][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Some animation timings are off.[/*]
[*]*If chosen at the start, Marnie won't show up until the 20th of Spring, even after earning 1,000g. This does not effect any other pet.[/*]
[/list]
Let me know of any bugs I might've missed! This is my first time making a mod, so there's probably lots I can improve on.


*The problem with the adoption event has been found (thanks to  [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TheLimeyDragon]TheLimeyDragon[/url]), but fixing it would mean that any panda chosen at the start menu or bought before the fix will be gone and replaced with a vanilla pet. Luckily, waiting until the 20th isn't that bad, so unless this causes more issues, I think I'm going to keep it as is.

[center][img width=150,height=150]https://i.ibb.co/VWnB6wd3/Walking-Up.gif[/img][/center]
